notes.title: UPDATE 1.0.3 (THE FUTURE OF WORK ADVENTURE)
notes.notes:
GENERAL[/h2


 The Tutorial no longer opens automatically when starting the game (Instead, a constant animation is displayed on the button, encouraging the user to click it).
 Number of consumable items in the market [strike]3 ~ 7[/strike] -> 5.
 Copies of consumable items in the market [strike]1 ~ 5[/strike] -> 1.
 Price of consumable items in the market [strike]10x[/strike] -> 10 ~ 20x.


ATTRIBUTES[/h2


 Energy consumption [strike]0.5[/strike] -> 1.0 ... 1.1 ... 1.2 (Increases every 5 levels).
 Starting Energy [strike]20[/strike] -> 50.


TASK SYSTEM[/h2


 A TASK SYSTEM has been added to the game!
 The game now features random missions that can be obtained upon leveling up. Tasks are divided into groups: Gathering, Destruction, Building, and Taming.
 A progression system has been implemented, making tasks harder as you advance, but providing greater rewards.


RESOURCES AND RESOURCE POINTS[/h2


 Entities and objects defeated to gain points [strike]10[/strike] -> 15.
 Initial number of jars and chests/boxes [strike]15[/strike] -> 1.
 Maximum number of jars and chests/boxes [strike]22[/strike] -> 5.
 Cost to increase the number of jars and chests/boxes [strike]1[/strike] -> 10.
 Cost to increase the maximum number of entities [strike]1[/strike] -> 3.
 Luck increase per point invested [strike]0.5%[/strike] -> 1.0%.
 Cost to increase luck [strike]1[/strike] -> 5.
 Creature spawn time [strike]25 ~ 50s - 7 ~ 14s[/strike] -> 120 ~ 300s - 30 ~ 75s.
 Resource spawn time [strike]10 ~ 15s - 1 ~ 2s[/strike] -> 30 ~ 60s -> 4 ~ 8s.


BUG FIXES[/h2


 Fixed a bug in buildings that generated experience gains for the user.
 Fixed a bug where mouse panning didn't work at 3X zoom.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.0.2
notes.notes:
IMPROVEMENTS


 Buildings now provide benefits to the player (Max Energy, Energy per Second, Attack, Experience Gain).
 The inventory now opens with a pre-selected filter.
 The Music icon has been replaced with a Volume icon.
 Tooltips have been added when hovering over the inventory filters.
 The Tutorial now opens when starting the game.
 A popup appears when starting a new game (Prevents accidental clicks from deleting the old save).


BUG FIXES


 Fixed a bug that prevented consumable items from being placed on the ground.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.0.1
notes.notes:
In this update, several improvements have been made for users! These include:  

IMPROVEMENTS  

  
 ENERGY COST PER ACTION HAS BEEN REDUCED: 1 -> 0.5  
 Right-click now moves the map (Mouse Pan)  
 Hovering the mouse over a creature now displays its name! (This can be disabled in settings)  
 Taming items left on the ground (with a visible aura) now return to the inventory after right-clicking  
 Pressing the "X" on buildings or the inventory returns resources to the inventory and cancels the current action  
 Minimum spawn time for resources has been reduced by 0.1 seconds for the minimum and 0.5 seconds for the maximum. With all points invested, the total cooldown is reduced to 1~2 seconds  
 Added a LUCK resource, granting a bonus to resource drops from OBJECTS ranging from 0~25% additional chances  
 Added 3X Zoom to the game  
 Added buttons to mute music and sound effects on the main menu  
 Added four filter buttons in the inventory to view items by category  
 Added a button to sell all items in the inventory based on the selected category  
 Standardized the "X" button to close windows across all game screens  
  

BUG FIXES  

  
 Fixed a bug that prevented users with multiple monitors from selecting other screens  
 Fixed a bug where the game's main menu did not adapt to the correct resolution on 2560x1440 and 3840x2160 monitors
